training_sources: Split-permitted labelled rows and their forms, plus public lexicon. Validation calibration uses raw kb_only predictions on frozen validation rows; test refit uses the complete outer training pool.
factual_asset_provenance: Rebuilt per split from permitted training-form rows and lexicon; no full-practice form cache.

confidence.semantics: Laplace-smoothed validation empirical correctness by emitted true/false label; hybrid unresolved fallback confidence is uncalibrated model probability.
confidence.calibration: kb_only validation predictions on validation_ids; gold unsure is an error for T/F decisions.
confidence.reliability_claim: No reliability guarantee; report empirical estimates with validation counts and prior-only status.

leakage_audit.detail: Separate method subprocess receives sanitized runtime CSV and train-only forms CSV. Gold test labels/forms remain evaluator-side; no OS filesystem sandbox is enforced.

added_training_material: No external facts or pretrained factual assets; hybrid uses predeclared word_char_lr_balanced text model.
assumptions: Same-date conservative evidence only; no time carry-forward.
Hybrid fallback is used only for unresolved KB rows.
same_date_limitations: Conservative same-date evidence provides limited coverage; no temporal persistence or carry-forward is assumed.
reproduction_note: Validation gold is held in evaluator memory and used only to fit the per-label Laplace confidence JSON. It is never written under method input or artifacts.
